subject: PO field validation & net-term exception proposal for HelixWave onboarding
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@helixwave.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO metadata + payment terms (HelixWave)

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding touchpoint. We're preparing our initial PO and wanted to confirm a few things on Redwood's side so the PO -> AP mapping works without delays:

- PO number field expected on the invoice (free-text vs. structured).
- Required PO line-item fields (cost center, project code, SKU) — we can populate custom fields if needed.
- Preferred invoice delivery (email to ap@redwood.com vs portal ingestion).
- Remittance remit address for cross-border wire instructions.

On payment terms: our standard is Net60 but we can accept Net45 if Redwood can confirm a monthly cutoff day and that invoices issued after the cutoff are processed on the following cycle. We'd also be open to an early-pay discount (2%/15) if Redwood is able to pay within 15 days.

I've attached our PO template (helixwave_po_template_v3.pdf) and a sample invoice. Can you confirm which Net-term you can commit to for the first 90 days while we finalize PO mapping?

Thanks,
Daniel Cho
Head of Procurement
HelixWave Systems
procure@helixwave.io

Attachment: helixwave_po_template_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 124KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@helixwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO metadata + payment terms (HelixWave)

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the template and the clear asks. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- PO number: we require a structured PO number field on the invoice (PO-XXXX-YYYY). Our AP system maps that to the order_id header; free-text is prone to routing delays.
- Line items: cost center and project code are optional but we prefer both. If you include a custom field called "rw_project_code" we'll map automatically.
- Invoice ingestion: we support ap@redwood.com ingestion and a portal drop (SFTP). For now, ap@redwood.com is fastest to get you into our ingestion queue.
- Remit: I'll include our wire instructions in the signature for now; our finance team may request a W-9 or VAT form for cross-border wires.

On terms: our standard vendor net-term for new suppliers is Net45. For a temporary Net60 we need a signed exception and revenue justification (one-time pilot). We can, however, do a Net45 + early-pay pilot at 1%/10 for the first 90 days to speed cash for you and tighten our unit economics.

Can you confirm whether HelixWave can shift to monthly statements with a month-end cutoff on the 1st calendar day (i.e., invoices received by the 1st processed in that month)? If yes, I'll loop in Marissa to prepare the exception sheet and Ben on the PO field mapping.

If agreeable, I'll send a DocuSign for the net-term exception and the PO mapping checklist today.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

---
Wire remit (provisional): Redwood Inference, Bank: First Coastal, Account: ****1234 (we'll provide formal banking details after KYC).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: HelixWave terms recommendation (re: Daniel's request)

Sofia / Ben —

Quick internal note (replying inline to Daniel's request):

On Sat, Nov 27, 2027 at 09:12 AM Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@helixwave.io> wrote:
> On payment terms: our standard is Net60 but we can accept Net45 if Redwood can confirm a monthly cutoff day and that invoices issued after the cutoff are processed on the following cycle.

Finance view: We should avoid a blanket Net60. Net45 is acceptable for new vendors if we get monthly statements and the PO metadata mapping is validated. For the early-pay ask, 2%/15 is a bit high for us at scale — propose 1%/10 or 0.5%/7 as an incentive that's easier to approve.

Operational asks: Ben, please confirm we can add a validation rule to our ingestion that maps "rw_project_code" and requires the PO- prefixed order_id. If we can do that, it will eliminate manual reconciliations and make Net45 feasible.

I'll prepare the signed-exception spreadsheet (signed-ma-netterms-exception.xlsx) with a proposed 90-day pilot: Net45 + 1%/10 early-pay. If HelixWave signs, CS & AP will route the first month's payment as early pay where applicable.

Marissa
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@helixwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO metadata + payment terms (HelixWave)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for confirming the template. Based on our ops/finance review, we can proceed with the following mutual action plan: 

1) Terms: Net45 for the initial 90-day onboarding pilot + early-pay incentive 1% if paid within 10 days (1%/10).
2) Cutoff: Monthly statement cutoff = invoices received by the 1st of the month will be processed for that month's cycle. Invoices after the 1st move to the next cycle.
3) PO fields: Please populate PO number as PO-XXXX-YYYY and include rw_project_code when applicable. We'll add an ingestion validation for that field.
4) Docs: I've initiated a DocuSign powerform for the net-term exception (link below). Please sign the attached exception spreadsheet after you confirm acceptance.

DocuSign (powerform): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

Proc ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-9823

If you'd like, I can set a 30-minute call this week to walk through the PO template and show where rw_project_code should live.

Best regards,
